episode.subject: Lycogala slime mold
episode.title: Before the hand left
episode.body: A finger pressed down and a pale cloud burst out of me. I wanted it to go away. Then it lifted, carrying some of me on its skin, and I wanted it to wait.

sourceEvidence.description:
Mature, brown aethalia with a powdery mass of lavender spores inside. Some had already burst out through the little holes.

Habitat: Growing on rotting wood in a deciduous, swampy forest.

proposals.imageReview: PASS recommendation for independent review. Exact image individually opened. Finger pressure, collapsed/open mature fruiting material, pale debris on the fingertip and airborne spore cloud are visible. Motion streaks belong to released material; they are not a substitute for a sharp focal subject. Companion 111040527 sharply resolves a mature perforated outer wall. Companion 111040619 shows discharge from a touched body under a small stick. Only the fingertip image is proposed as an entry. No crop or editing. Original upload metadata 2048 x 1691 is separate from the reviewed 1024 x 846 delivery.
proposals.proseAssessment: PASS recommendation. Oona first wants the intrusive finger gone, then wants it to remain once part of her material is leaving with it. The reversal is caused by visible bodily dispersal, not advice, an abstract moral or offspring described as departing children. This continues her difficult attachment without another crowding argument or a human recoiling in fear. It is uneasy rather than a joke about suffering. No active choice to release spores is asserted.

canon.home: Damp deadwood in a central European woodland, 48.95, 9.1 unchanged. Connecticut is source locality only.
canon.identity: Genus Lycogala retained. The spore material described as some of me is fictional continuity of a fruiting body with its contents, not proof of one conscious distributed organism or identical genomes.

holds.title: The lifted roof
holds.body: The bark above us lifted. Light reached a side of me that had never needed to be presentable. I wanted the shade back until the person leaned closer. Then I wanted a little time to prepare.
